title: Events alert — 2026-11-12
body:
Just landed: CoreWeave closed +~25% on Nov 11 — Q3 beat, $132.5B backlog, FY guide raised, ~$9B customer prepayments promised within three months. Sparked an AI rebound (Nasdaq +1.6%, Nebius +15%, IREN +5.7%); financing fear soothed, not cured (capex $37–39B; no positive net income before H1 2028). Siemens FY26 today 07:00 Berlin: record €108B orders, EPS €11.76 above guidance, dividend €5.50, 34.1% Healthineers spin-off by May 2027; XETRA reacts from 09:00.

Due: Nebius Q3 premarket today (~13:00 Berlin; call 14:00) — ~$907M revenue expected, the debt-funded-backlog test. Applied Materials FQ4 tonight (release ~22:00 Berlin; call 22:30) — first >$10B quarter, ~$10.3B / ~$4.06 EPS consensus; 2027 WFE outlook decides. Tomorrow 14:30 Berlin: October PPI (some calendars flag shutdown-shifted dates). Nvidia confirmed Nov 17.

Sleeves: infrastructure relieved, semis event-loaded tonight; power constructive; 15% cash holds.

Sources: web search 2026-11-12 (Siemens press/Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance/TipRanks/ainvest on CRWV, Investing.com/mitrade NBIS preview, MarketBeat/Zacks AMAT, Nvidia IR, marketscreener/ABM agendas).
